wizard.aiFlag: Heads up: this photo looks AI-generated. You can still submit — it will be flagged for review.
wizard.dragHint: Drag the pin or tap the map to adjust the location.
wizard.descOptional: Optional — a short note helps sort the issue faster.

wizard.successText: Thanks for helping improve your area. Your report is now on the map.
